Here is your PRD in plain TXT format (ready to give to AI agent or save as .txt):

PG LIKE HOME – PUBLIC WEBSITE PRD (PHASE 1)

OBJECTIVE
Build a fast, SEO-friendly public website for “PG Like Home” to generate WhatsApp and phone enquiries, show rooms, pricing, facilities, food details, rules, gallery, and location.
No login system and no online booking in this phase.

TARGET USERS
Students near Gujarat University, IIM Ahmedabad, LD Engineering, HL College, CEPT, JG University, MG Science, working professionals, and parents.

SUCCESS METRICS
WhatsApp button clicks
Phone call clicks
Google Maps direction clicks
Time spent on site

TECH STACK
Framework: Next.js (App Router) with Static Site Generation
Styling: Tailwind CSS
UI (optional): ShadCN
Hosting: Vercel
Images: next/image optimization
SEO: Next.js metadata + Local Business schema

PAGES AND ROUTES

5.1 HOME (/)
Hero section with PG name, tagline “Comfort, Care & Feeling of Home” and Call + WhatsApp CTA
Quick highlights (Pure Veg Food, Wi-Fi, CCTV, RO Water, Housekeeping)
Room pricing cards (starting ₹9000)
Nearby colleges grid
Google Maps embed
Testimonials placeholder

5.2 ABOUT (/about)
Owner bio (Raj Parvadiya – Science teacher, BSc BEd)
Story behind PG and vision

5.3 ROOMS & PRICING (/rooms)
Pricing table with room type, AC/Non-AC, rent, deposit, electricity, and included facilities

Room data:
Non AC Hall – 9000
Non AC 3 Sharing – 10000
AC 3 Sharing – 11000
AC 2 Sharing – 14500
AC 1 Sharing – 20000
Deposit: One month rent
Electricity: Included (AC extra)
Includes: Food, Wi-Fi, Cleaning, RO Water

5.4 FACILITIES (/facilities)
Icon grid: Wi-Fi, Pure Veg Food, Laundry, Housekeeping, RO Water, Power Backup, Parking, CCTV, Study Table, Cupboard/Locker, 24×7 Water

5.5 FOOD (/food)
Pure veg meals (breakfast, lunch, dinner)
Student-decided weekly menu
Outside food allowed
Hygienic kitchen

5.6 RULES (/rules)
No smoking inside PG
No alcohol
1 month notice required
No refund without notice
No time limit for entry

5.7 GALLERY (/gallery)
Categories: Rooms, Dining, Building, Common area
Images stored in public folder or Cloudinary

5.8 CONTACT (/contact)
Call button: 9054499036
WhatsApp button: 9925574196
Email: pglikehome1@gmail.com

Address: C7, 1st Floor, Nilmani Society, Memnagar, beside Sterling Hospital
Google Maps embed
Get directions button

GLOBAL COMPONENTS
Navbar with logo/name, menu links, Call button, WhatsApp button
Footer with contact info and quick links
Floating WhatsApp and Call buttons

SEO REQUIREMENTS
Keywords: PG in Memnagar, PG near Gujarat University, PG near IIM Ahmedabad, Student PG in Ahmedabad
Each page must have title, meta description, and OpenGraph tags
Add Local Business schema with address, phone, and map

PERFORMANCE REQUIREMENTS
Lighthouse score above 90
Mobile-first responsive design
Lazy load gallery images
Use next/image optimization

DESIGN GUIDELINES
Clean, student-friendly UI
White + blue/green color theme
Card-based layout
Large CTA buttons

CONTENT SOURCE
All content provided from PG Like Home details form.

FUTURE COMPATIBILITY
Structure should allow adding /dashboard route later for resident login and Supabase integration.

TIMELINE
UI design – 1 day
Development – 2 to 3 days
SEO and testing – 1 day
Total – 4 to 5 days

DEFINITION OF DONE
